title: ARTEX AI Agents Reportedly Used Stolen Cloud Backup Credentials to Access ConnectWise Customers' Microsoft 365 Environments
summary: Microsoft reported that China-aligned hackers used ARTEX, an AI penetration-testing framework, to access customers' Microsoft 365 environments through stolen credentials for ConnectWise's cloud backup services. Agents reportedly changed credentials and privileges in some environments to retain unauthorized access. The activity formed part of a global campaign; the extent of compromise and any data theft remained uncertain.
